service.title: What Service Do We Offer?
paragraphs: Our service is a digital solution designed to digitize your business workflows, reduce the number of repetitive operations, and bring your company's internal activities into a single system. Such a service automates tasks that are performed repeatedly and can be handled by software, saves your employees' time, and reduces unnecessary actions throughout the workflow.

Our service can be thought of as the digital brain of your business. It keeps track of how your business is performing, how each particular area of the company is doing, what changes are happening in your sales, and how other important business indicators are moving. When information from different processes is collected, aggregated, and presented in one place, you gain a much clearer understanding of what is actually happening inside your business. This allows you to make decisions based on comprehensive information rather than isolated numbers and plan your next steps with greater accuracy.

A properly designed system also allows you to use your workforce more efficiently. Instead of spending employees' time on tasks that software can perform, you can direct their attention toward work that requires human thinking, supervision, judgment, and decision-making. In some processes, the system does not replace an employee entirely but works alongside them by preparing the information they need, handling calculations, or taking repetitive operations off their hands. This ultimately allows your business to use valuable resources such as time, human labor, and money more efficiently.

mission.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: We provide customized digital solutions for businesses that want to improve their internal processes, grow their operations, and use technology in a practical way. Our goal is not to force your business into a predefined system, but to understand how your business actually works and build a solution around its specific needs. The systems we create should simplify workflows, improve management, and provide a reliable technical foundation for the company's future growth.

We deliberately intend to build long-term relationships with our clients rather than treating a project as something that ends the moment the product is delivered. We want to continue working with businesses, growing within our field, and constantly researching new technologies and opportunities that can provide businesses with unique solutions. For us, a new technology is not simply another tool to add to our stack. It is an opportunity to look at a business problem from a different perspective and find a solution beyond conventional approaches.

feedback.title: We Value Our Clients and Their Feedback
paragraphs: For us, completing a project is not defined simply by delivering the finished product. One of the most important measures of our work is what the client actually thinks about the result. That is why we place significant value on your genuine feedback after using our service. What you liked, what could have been done better, or where we failed to meet your expectations — all of this becomes a source of experience and a learning point that we carry into our future work.

We do not consider a project successfully delivered simply because the system is technically complete. The real result is achieved when the client is genuinely satisfied with the system, sees real value in it for their business, and wants to continue working with us in the future.

We do not build projects simply to mark the next item on a task list as completed. We are genuinely committed to the work we do, and we take responsibility for the outcome of every project and the value it is expected to create for your business.

stages.title: Discovery Phase
body: During the Discovery phase, we gain a comprehensive understanding of your business, workflows, and goals. We do not organize this process simply to get to know you and your business. During our 30-minute conversation, we identify problems within your workflows that may have gone unnoticed and gain a deeper understanding of your existing challenges in order to find effective solutions.

stages.title: Planning Phase
body: After reaching an agreement with you, we use the information collected during the Discovery phase to develop a detailed technical plan. During this stage, our team works together to analyze the internal infrastructure of the required system, its system design, and other technical aspects, and then develops a comprehensive implementation plan.

You also take an active role in this process. Throughout the planning stage, we work with you to determine and approve what each part of the system should contain and how it should work. We move to the development stage only after the entire plan has been fully approved, at which point the approved plan becomes the fixed foundation for development. This is essential for delivering a high-quality and consistent system.

stages.title: Development Phase
body: Once the planning phase is complete, we begin developing the system according to the detailed and carefully prepared technical plan. The development is carried out by our team of experienced developers with years of professional experience.

One of the things that distinguishes us from other IT companies is our emphasis on open communication throughout the development process. Our team openly discusses technical decisions, points out each other’s mistakes, and critically evaluates technical conclusions. This approach makes a significant contribution to continuously improving the quality of our work.

stages.title: Testing Phase
body: Throughout the testing phase, our experienced QA testers continuously test the developed product. We examine various aspects of the system, including internal errors, design issues, inconsistent animations, long-term concerns, system performance under high loads, and other potential problems.

stages.title: Deployment Phase
body: Once the product is complete, we move to the deployment stage, which means placing the system on an online server. In order for the finished product to remain continuously available and operate reliably for users, it needs to be deployed to a dedicated server accessible through the internet.

stages.title: Ongoing Support
body: We do not consider our cooperation complete once the finished product has been delivered. We continue to support you in maintaining the system’s stable operation, resolving issues that may arise, and adding new features whenever necessary.

testimonials.title: What our Clients say About PFC Solutions

items.body: For several months, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of our company’s internal workflows and searched for an IT company capable of finding solutions to our problems. We spent considerable time discussing our business and work processes in detail with PFC Solutions. During those conversations, my initial assumption that PFC Solutions was a conventional team like other companies changed completely. Most interestingly, we did not have to adapt to the software they developed or study it separately at all. The system interface is intuitive, and its performance is exceptionally fast. I hope we will collaborate with PFC Solutions again in the future.
items.name: Ahror Nazarov

items.body: We already had our own internal software and also used 1C. In many cases, the financial indicators and calculations entered into 1C differed from the data in our internal system. Identifying and resolving these discrepancies alone used to take us several hours. During the Discovery process, PFC Solutions communicated with us actively, identified the problem quickly, and proposed an effective solution we had not expected. Their working process and team cohesion were clearly evident throughout our online meetings. I believe our partnership with PFC Solutions will continue for many years.

We had hired several specialized professionals to analyze the data entered into the system and make business decisions based on it. Even so, the process took a great deal of time. Frankly, as a construction company, we did not know exactly which direction to take or what solution we needed. We therefore began looking for the best specialists in the field and discovered PFC Solutions. They developed an artificial intelligence agent tailored to our company’s needs. Our workflows are now approximately 45 percent faster. As a result, our existing workforce can complete almost twice as much work.
